title: a semiprivate room needs component 0x0007 listed and supported
description:
Found while testing the hub's external_receivers check (bead
mimid-1wgh.4.79.2), 2026-11-26. Two red runs in a row, each a different
half of the same rule.

Because `external_receivers` is a component (decision mimid-1wgh.4.79.4)
rather than a GroupContext extension, mls-extensions-11 §5 applies to it
in full. A room that uses SemiPrivateMessage handshakes therefore needs
both of:

1. `0x0007` in the group's `app_components` list, or the component
   carries no data -- `ComponentNotListed(7)`.
2. `0x0007` in the `app_components` capability of every member's leaf,
   including every leaf added later, or the Commit is invalid --
   `MissingAppComponent(7)`.

Neither is a rule mimid invented; both fall out of §5, and mimid's own
component machinery enforces them already. What is worth writing down is
the consequence, which the draft does not mention: a room cannot turn
semiprivate handshakes on later without every member first updating its
leaf to declare the component. The members have to support it before the
room can list it.

That ordering is a deployment constraint on anyone using this draft, and
a candidate for item 8 of bead mimid-1wgh.44.22: the draft says how to
send and read a SemiPrivateMessage and never says that the component
itself has to be negotiated first.

The hub does not need to check either one. A group that fails them
cannot produce a valid Commit, so the state never reaches the hub.
